text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Stay alert, Nakayama... The real natto
rice game
starts here!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Again, what in the hell kind of
game are you
even talking about?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You always have some crazy surprises up
your
sleeve, don't you, Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Bring it on, Nakayama. Bet you've
never
seasoned rice with your life on the
line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer. We'll talk after. For
now, just
watch and learn a little
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa has a cheerful smile. I
don't
know what's about to happen, but
it looks like
she got a lot of rest on her
day off!
